meta.title: MILLI — A 5-axis CNC is coming
meta.description: MILLI is an upcoming 5-axis CNC milling machine sold as a kit, with a planned introductory price of $1,499. Join the Insider List to be first.

hero.title: MILLI IS COMING.
hero.subtitle: The future of 5-axis CNC is closer than you think.
hero.priceNote: Planned introductory price. Subject to final confirmation.

countdown.caption: Until the reveal
countdown.zeroText: Stay close. The reveal is being prepared.

mystery.title: SOMETHING BIG IS COMING.
mystery.text: Five axes. One unexpected price. A completely new way to think about CNC.
mystery.final: Not everything is meant to be revealed. Yet.

proof.title: DON'T BELIEVE IT?
proof.subtitle: Parts machined on the MILLI prototype. Nothing else.
proof.emptyTitle: The first cuts are on their way.
proof.emptyText: Demonstrations appear here once they have been filmed on the MILLI prototype and technically validated. We will not show anything else.

challenge.title: WHAT WOULD YOU CREATE?
challenge.subtitle: Imagine what you could build with five axes.
challenge.intro: Send us the part you dream of machining. The best ideas are selected, published and put to the vote.
